description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'UpdatePasswordAPI' for handling password update requests within the OrangeHRM system's PIM module. It includes methods for updating a user's password, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: UpdatePasswordAPI
classes.description: An API endpoint class for updating user passwords via a RESTful PUT request, implementing validation, and integrating with the user service and role management traits.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as retrieval by ID is not supported for this endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns a not implemented exception, indicating no validation rules for get operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles the password update request, sets new password, updates modification date, and saves the user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update request, including current password verification and new password validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, as delete operation is not supported for this endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns a not implemented exception, indicating no validation rules for delete operation.
